description: Find people across every public portfolio on made.show by free text (name with or without accents, headline, bio, role titles, organizations, skills), skills, location or availability. Returns short summaries with one suggested follow-up prompt each; call get_profile or get_portfolio for depth.

availability.description: open: looking now. passive: open to the right offer. not_looking: not looking

discipline.description: What they do: designers, developers (engineering), product managers or writers. Self-chosen, so also check their roles.

limit.description: How many people to return, 1 to 25

query.description: Free text: a name, role, company, skill or anything in a bio, e.g. "design systems lead fintech" or "backend go payments"

remoteOnly.description: Only people open to remote work

skills.description: All listed skills must be evidenced

name: search_people
title: Search people
